textDisplay: This is exactly what I needed! Just got my first interview thanks to project #3. The e-commerce store really impressed them.
Question: for project 2 (real-time chat), did you use WebSockets or Socket.io? Which would you recommend for a portfolio piece?

Great question! I used Socket.io because it handles reconnection and fallbacks automatically. For a portfolio piece, Socket.io is perfect — it shows you understand real-time concepts without reinventing the wheel.

What was your tech stack? I'm trying to do something similar but can't decide between Next.js and SvelteKit.
I went with Next.js + Supabase + Stripe. Next.js was the right call for speed — the app router and server components made the MVP faster to build. SvelteKit would work great too though!
